name: ecDHFR
title: E. coli dihydrofolate reductase: apo, methotrexate and trimethoprim states
grouping: Entries whose sequences align to the ecDHFR HDX construct (His-tag and TEV site excluded).

members.title: ecDHFR: peptide-level HDX-MS, APO / MTX / TMP
5DFR: CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF UNLIGANDED ESCHERICHIA COLI DIHYDROFOLATE REDUCTASE. LIGAND-INDUCED CONFORMATIONAL CHANGES AND COOPERATIVITY IN BINDING
6XG5: X-ray structure of Escherichia coli dihydrofolate reductase in complex with trimethoprim

construct.note: His-tag and TEV site (MTGHHHHHHENLYFQ) precede ecDHFR; S16 replaces M1

structures.title: CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF UNLIGANDED ESCHERICHIA COLI DIHYDROFOLATE REDUCTASE. LIGAND-INDUCED CONFORMATIONAL CHANGES AND COOPERATIVITY IN BINDING
X-ray structure of Escherichia coli dihydrofolate reductase in complex with trimethoprim
notes: sequence differs from the HDX construct at label_seq_id 37: D (construct) vs N (structure)
contains ligands not in the HDX state: NDP

merge.method: intensity-weighted mean of uptake across charge states
merge.weight: summed intensity of the MATCH envelope peaks; unweighted mean when no peaks are listed
merge.keeps: per-charge records in the HXMS file

time_bins.method: consecutive labeling times grouped while t <= 1.15 x the first time of the group
time_bins.reason: actual times come from instrument logs and differ slightly by replicate

correction.D_FD: mean uptake at TIME = inf, same state, all replicates

differential.test: hybrid significance: Welch t-test per peptide and time AND |dD| > global limit (Hageman & Weis, Anal. Chem. 2019)
differential.global_limit: t(1 - alpha/2, df) x s_pooled x sqrt(2 / n)
differential.values: uncorrected uptake (Da); a state-independent back-exchange cancels in the difference
differential.replicates: only replicate ids present in both states (same-day pairing)
differential.zero_variance: p undefined (null) and not significant when all replicate values are identical

classification.more rigid: uptake significantly lower with ligand at one or more times, never higher
classification.more flexible: significantly higher at one or more times, never lower
classification.mixed: significantly lower at some times and higher at others
classification.not tested: fewer than 2 paired replicates at every time

projection.method: a residue takes the classes of the peptides whose exchangeable span covers it (first 2 residues excluded)
projection.class: more rigid or more flexible if all significant covering peptides agree; mixed if they disagree
projection.value: mean over covering tested peptides of max-|dD| / N_ex (signed), weighted by 1 / peptide length

mapping.method: construct residue mapped to each structure's label_seq_id by sequence alignment (difflib, blocks > 5 residues)

ligand_contacts.method: polymer residues of the reference chain with a heavy atom within the cutoff of a ligand heavy atom
ligand_contacts.model: first model; same asymmetric unit, no symmetry mates
ligand_contacts.excluded_reason: water, chloride and glycerol: crystallization or cryoprotection components
ligand_contacts.numbering: contacts mapped to construct positions through the structure alignment
ligand_contacts.status: a contact marks where a ligand sits in a crystal structure; it is not an HDX observation

identification_protocol: We used Compass DataAnalysis 5.1 (Bruker) to identify and deconvolute peptides. To match sequences to these peptides, we used Biotools 3.2 (Bruker) SequenceEditor with no enzyme specified, 30 ppm error range, 0.020 Da error for MSMS, 20 partials, a mass range of 150 to 25000 da, using monoisotopic ions. The resulting peptide list was used for peptide deconvolution by PIGEON.

artifacts.title: 5 raw Bruker .d archives (ecDHFR replicates), including fully deuterated controls
13 MS/MS search files (.mgf) of undeuterated samples
L1a peptide identification: 11 peptide lists, raw and curated (CLEANED)
L1b uptake per charge state with envelopes (3 HXMS files: APO, MTX, TMP); L1c fully deuterated controls (TIME = inf)
L1b uptake with charge states merged (computed here)
L1d corrected uptake, FD-normalized (computed here; uncorrected kept)
L1 technical reproducibility: replicate SD per peptide and time (computed here)
Model: differential classification and residue projection, APO vs MTX and APO vs TMP (computed here)
PDB 5DFR: x-ray diffraction, 2.3 Å; ligands CL
PDB 1RG7: x-ray diffraction, 2.0 Å; ligands MTX
PDB 6XG5: x-ray diffraction, 1.9 Å; ligands CL, GOL, NDP, TOP
L3 mapping to structural models: residue classes on 5DFR, 1RG7, 6XG5 (computed here)

runs.description: Peptide identification from MS/MS: no enzyme, 30 ppm, 0.020 Da MS/MS, 20 partials, 150-25000 Da, monoisotopic
Peptide pool deconvolution (PIGEON), deuterated envelope extraction (HDExaminer), conversion to HXMS (PFLink)
runs.parsed_from: PRIDE protocol and HXMS paper; HDExaminer and PFLink versions not stated

runs.description: Merge charge states (intensity-weighted mean); group labeling times (15% tolerance)
Back-exchange correction by FD normalization: D_corr = D / D_FD x N_ex; uncorrected values kept
Replicate standard deviation per peptide and time; median, 95th percentile and pooled SD per state
Hybrid significance test per peptide and time (alpha 0.01, same-day replicates), peptide classes, residue projection
Map residue classes onto each structure by sequence alignment; record mismatches
Ligand contacts per reference structure: heavy atoms within 4.0 Å, mapped to construct positions
